proof:
Source: step 6 (spt Y ⊆ K, with V = ℝ^P) and (B1) (spt(Z|_U) ⊆ K, with V = U) of the parent proof, in one common form. Recall that Z.VanishesOn W means Z(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ D^q(V) with tsupport ω ⊆ W.

1. Let x ∈ spt Z, so x ∈ V and x ∉ zeroRegion(Z). Suppose, for a contradiction, that x ∉ K.
2. V ∖ K is open (V open, K closed; IsOpen.sdiff) and contains x. So there is ε > 0 with ball(x, ε) ⊆ V ∖ K (Metric.isOpen_iff). Put r := ε/2 > 0 and W := ball(x, r).
3. Properties of W.
   - W is open.
   - closure W ⊆ closedBall(x, r) (closure_ball_subset_closedBall). closedBall(x, r) is compact because ℝ^P is a proper space (isCompact_closedBall), and closure W is closed, so closure W is compact.
   - closedBall(x, r) ⊆ ball(x, ε) since r < ε (closedBall_subset_ball). Hence closure W ⊆ ball(x, ε) ⊆ V ∖ K ⊆ V.
4. Z.VanishesOn W. Let ω ∈ D^q(V) with tsupport ω ⊆ W. Since W ⊆ ball(x, ε) ⊆ ℝ^P ∖ K, tsupport ω is disjoint from K, so Z(ω) = 0 by hypothesis.
5. By steps 3–4, W is one of the sets whose union is zeroRegion(Z), and x ∈ W because r > 0. So x ∈ zeroRegion(Z), contradicting step 1. Hence x ∈ K, and spt Z ⊆ K. ∎

theorem Submission.fiw_tb_ext_support_subset : ∀ (P q : ℕ) (V K : Set (Eucl P)) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn V q), IsOpen V → IsClosed K → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V q, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q)) K → Z ω = 0) → Z.support ⊆ K := by
  intro P q V K Z hV hK hZ x hx
  by_contra hxK
  obtain ⟨hxV, hxz⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hV.sdiff hK) x ⟨hxV, hxK⟩
  apply hxz
  refine ⟨ball x (ε / 2), ⟨isOpen_ball, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, mem_ball_self (half_pos hε)⟩
  · exact (isCompact_closedBall x (ε / 2)).of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure
      closure_ball_subset_closedBall
  · exact (closure_ball_subset_closedBall.trans
      (closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hε))).trans (hball.trans sdiff_subset)
  · intro ω hω
    apply hZ
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro y hy hyK
    exact (hball (ball_subset_ball (half_le_self hε.le) (hω hy))).2 hyK
key_steps: For x ∈ spt Z ∖ K, V ∖ K is an open neighbourhood of x; choose ball(x, ε) ⊆ V ∖ K.
W := ball(x, ε/2) is open with compact closure ⊆ V. Every test form supported in W has support disjoint from K, so Z vanishes on W.
Hence x ∈ zeroRegion(Z), contradicting x ∈ spt Z.
